about: Canon layout of the 50-silo complex, in units of the flower edge (centre to centre of neighbouring silos). Silo 1 at 0,0; the entry gate on the axis road due north (-y). x east, y south, as a Minecraft map. Fitted jointly (tools/silo/canon_fit.py) to two images from the show: the founders' plaque at the opening (S3E09, all 50 numbers) and the high oblique of the whole complex in 2052 (S3; Reddit r/SiloTVSeries 1wf7vy8, frame 1). Each flower is a regular hexagon of equal edge; a homography maps the ground to each image. Residuals: plaque 6.0 px rms, frame 11.3 px rms. Silos 2-6, 16, 45 and the gate are free points.
edge_source: Frame 1, rectified by the fit: every ring's outer pale circle maps to a circle of 0.82 edge (0.77-0.91 over five rings, across and along). That circle is where the explorethesilo model's crater returns to the plain (r 64 m; its dark berm ring at r 42 sits at 0.67 of it, as in the frame), so edge = 128 / 0.82 = 156 m. The model's own neighbouring craters lie 170 and 190 m from it.
